The following changes have been made to the Community Development Block Grant EIR/EIS. The page numbers precede the changes and name in ( ) indicates commenting agency or individual:
Page 8, second paragraph under Backesto Park, will be changed to read:

This project will also provide $11,000 for construction of a PAR

physical fitness course. (Parks and Recreation)
Page 18, Olinder CNRA: Sentence referring to East San Jose Carnegie Library change 24th Street to 23rd Street. (Gordon Schmelzer)
Page 66, first sentence under discussion of Neighborhood Parks, should be changed to read, "These are normally three to eight ..." (Parks and Recreation)
Page 83, the statement to the effect that the liquefaction problem is not severe enough to warrant a negative impact ... is correct. The statement at the bottom of page 101 "Construction of a ..." is therefore incorrect and should be deleted. (Parks and Recreation)
Page 86, first sentence under Community Facilities, should be changed to read, The <u>recommended</u> improvements to Backesto Park include the construction of a shelter-type recreation building, <u>subject to citizen approval</u> in the park master planning process. (Parks and Recreation)
Page 87, Delete the third sentence relating to an E.I.R. having been prepared. (Parks and Recreation)
Page 98, D. Flora and Fauna, Alma CNRA: Change the word will to the word should, as recommended. (Parks and Recreation)
Pages 105 and 106, Park Acquisition and Improvement Alternative.

<u>Delete</u> the second and third paragraphs on page 105 and the first paragraph on page 106. (Parks and Recreation)
